h1: Meet Gagan Deep, the brewmaster behind Hops n Grains
title: Gagan Deep, Brewmaster at Hops n Grains | Craft Beer School
desc: Who Gagan Deep is, the brewpub he brews for in Panchkula, Chandigarh and Mohali, plus what his career shows anyone who wants to brew for a living.
teaser: Founders get the headlines. The beer comes from the brewmaster. Meet the man on the brew deck at the Tricity's oldest microbrewery.
standfirst: Gagan Deep is the in-house brewmaster at Hops n Grains, the brewpub group that brought craft beer to Chandigarh, Panchkula and Mohali. Here is what the public record says about his work and what it teaches anyone who wants the job.
sections:
Hops n Grains belongs to Amritanshu Agrawal and Dr Priyanka Gupta. They founded it, they run it and they give most of the interviews. Gagan Deep is not a founder. He is the in-house brewmaster, the person who turns their menu of beers into something that actually pours.

That distinction matters if you are thinking about brewing as a career. Most brewers in India will never own the brewpub they brew for. They work for owners who know hospitality. The beer is their department. Gagan's career is a good example of how that role works when it works well.

By the founders' own account, Hops n Grains opened in Sector 9, Panchkula, in 2010 as the first microbrewery in the Tricity. Some press reports put the date later, around 2012, so treat the exact year with care. The group has since added The Great Bear in Chandigarh and a second Hops n Grains in Mohali, opened during the Covid years.

Panchkula is a three-floor brewpub with the vessels on show behind glass. The brewery's website now lists six seasonal beers on tap at any time, alongside the regulars. In a recent interview the founders called Gagan Deep their in-house brewmaster, with Dr S Cariappa, the Bengaluru brewer who commissioned the plant, as their mentor.

That pairing is common in Indian brewpubs. A senior consultant sets up the brewhouse, writes the first recipes and trains the team. A resident brewmaster then brews every day, keeps the cellar healthy and develops new beers. Our guide on when to hire a consultant brewmaster covers how the split usually works.

The resident brewer's job is the one that never stops. Yeast has to be pitched on time, tanks have to be cleaned and every beer has to taste the same on a Tuesday as it did on Saturday. A consultant can visit. Only the brewmaster is there when a fermenter runs warm at midnight.

The job behind a brewpub's taps is mostly routine, done precisely. A typical brew day starts early with milling and mashing in, then lautering, the boil and cooling the wort into a fermenter. Around that sit the daily checks: gravity and temperature readings on every fermenting tank, tasting each beer in the cellar, cleaning whatever was used and keeping the yeast healthy for the next pitch.

In the Tricity the weather adds its own work. Panchkula summers regularly pass 40 °C, so the glycol chiller that holds fermenters at temperature works hardest exactly when the taproom is busiest. A brewmaster in North India learns to watch that chiller as closely as any tank. Ordering malt and hops, keeping excise records and training junior brewers fill the rest of the week.
What he has said on the record

Gagan has spoken to the press only briefly. In 2018 he told The Tribune that the team had "been experimenting with seasonal beers and food that goes with it." At the time that meant a Belgian Dubbel with caramel and toffee notes, brewed for the cricket season with a matching menu.

He also told the paper that the brewery's original plant was Chinese and hard to assemble. Looking back on the years since, he added: "Thankfully, now the microbrewery industry has grown by leaps and bounds." Both remarks describe a brewer who started when there was little support around and has watched the trade grow up around him.
What his career shows a new brewer

You do not need to own a brewery to build a reputation. You need to stay with one long enough for its beer to become yours. Hops n Grains has kept its core beers on tap for well over a decade while adding seasonal and fruit beers. That takes a brewer who can hold consistency and still experiment.

It also takes a willingness to learn from a mentor. Working beside an experienced consultant is the fastest education a young brewer in India can get. The other route is structured training first, then a brewpub job. Our guide to becoming a brewer in India sets out both paths.
faqs: Is Gagan Deep the founder of Hops n Grains?
No. Hops n Grains was founded by Amritanshu Agrawal and Dr Priyanka Gupta. Gagan Deep is the brewery's in-house brewmaster.
The original brewpub is in Sector 9, Panchkula. The group also runs The Great Bear in Chandigarh and a Hops n Grains in Mohali.
Who commissioned the Hops n Grains brewery?
Dr S Cariappa, a Bengaluru brewmaster, helped set up and commission the plant. The founders still describe him as a mentor.
